agent.finish_summary: Fixed IndexError regression in sqlparse's PHP output format. In sqlparse/filters/output.py, OutputPHPFilter._process incorrectly used token.value.split('\n', 1)[2] (out of range since maxsplit=1 yields only indices 0-1) instead of [1], unlike the correct analogous code in OutputPythonFilter. Changed [2] to [1]. Verified with manual tests that single-line and multi-line queries formatted with output_format='php' now work correctly without raising IndexError.
